description.en: Plugins maintained by c3115644151 for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: c3115644151 为 DeepSeek Harness 维护的插件。

description.en: Reads one GitHub repository as one identity and keeps only the events that concern it: my failing PR, reviews requested of me, issues assigned to me, comments that mention me, default-branch CI. Items move through pending / delivered / done and queue by default (quiet) instead of opening a turn. Polls only at turn boundaries — nothing runs while the session is idle. GitHub only, for now.
description.zh: 只读一个 GitHub 仓库，按身份判断哪些事件与你有关：我作者的 PR 失败、我被请求评审、分配给我的 issue、@我的评论、默认分支 CI。条目分 pending / delivered / done 三态，默认只排队（quiet），不替你开轮；只在回合边界轮询，空闲时不访问 GitHub。目前仅支持 GitHub。
